versions.changelog:
Initial release of JARVIS UI for OpenClaw agents.

- Interactive Three.js orb visualizes agent state (thinking, speaking, idle)
- Real-time chat with Gateway WebSocket integration
- Audio spectrum analyzer with multiple visualization modes
- System monitor and live model usage stats
- Edge TTS (free, cross-platform) and macOS speech synthesis support
- Mobile responsive layout and PWA support
- Easy config and production-ready deployment instructions
